notices.text:
Calder Systems is open for business on Station Road. Calder is an AI system made by Calder Systems of Wenlow. It works for you, with the systems you choose to connect: your bank account, your household account, your business's ordering, till, payroll and books, and your messages. You tell it what you want in your own words, and you can change that whenever you like. For each system you choose the access it has: read only, act up to a dollar limit you set, or act freely. You can disconnect anything at any time.
Price: $15 a week for a person, $40 a week for a business, paid weekly. Cancel any time.
